title: Oraciones de relativo (who, which, that, where)
short: La amiga que vive en Valencia = the friend ==who== lives in Valencia. En inglés el «que» cambia según sea persona, cosa o lugar.

story.title: Unir dos frases con «que»
story.text: Para describir a alguien sin cortar la frase, la unimos con un ==relativo==: el «que» del español. En inglés hay que elegirlo bien.

examples.t: I have a friend. She makes amazing cakes.
examples.es: Tengo una amiga. Hace unas tartas buenísimas.

examples.t: I have a friend who makes amazing cakes.
examples.es: Tengo una amiga que hace unas tartas buenísimas.

story.title: ¿Cuál uso?
story.text: Depende de lo que haya ==delante==: una persona, una cosa o un lugar.

head: Relativo
Para…
Ejemplo
rows: the necklace ==which== my mum gave me
the man ==that== called / the bag ==that== I lost

story.title: No repitas el sujeto ni el objeto
story.text: El relativo ya ocupa el lugar de «él», «ella» o «lo». No lo repitas: the man who ==lives== here, nunca «who he lives».

examples.t: The man who lives upstairs is a doctor.
examples.es: El hombre que vive arriba es médico.

examples.t: The book that I'm reading is very sad.
examples.es: El libro que estoy leyendo es muy triste.

story.title: A veces se puede quitar
story.text: Si detrás del relativo viene ==otro sujeto== (I, you, my son…), puedes quitarlo. Si el relativo es el sujeto, no.

examples.t: The friend (that) I met in Rome is coming.
examples.es: Viene la amiga que conocí en Roma.

examples.t: The woman who called you is my cousin.
examples.es: La mujer que te ha llamado es mi prima.

story.title: En español, «que» vale para todo
story.text: Nosotras decimos «que» para personas y cosas, y «donde» para lugares. En inglés eliges: ==who== (persona), ==which== (cosa), ==that== (las dos), ==where== (lugar).

examples.t: The lady who helped me was very kind.
examples.es: La señora que me ayudó fue muy amable.

examples.t: The town where I was born is by the sea.
examples.es: El pueblo donde nací está junto al mar.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ the woman which lives… ✅ the woman ==who== lives…
❌ the man who he works… ✅ the man who ==works==…
❌ the cake that I made it ✅ the cake that I ==made==

compare.es: En español usamos «que» para personas y cosas («la vecina que…», «el bolso que…») y «donde» para lugares. Además, el «que» nunca se puede quitar.
compare.target: En inglés el relativo cambia: who para personas, which para cosas, that para las dos y where para lugares. No se repite el sujeto ni el objeto (the man who lives…, the cake that I made), y cuando detrás viene otro sujeto, el relativo se puede quitar: the friend I met in Rome.

errors.wrong: The woman which lives next door is very kind.
errors.right: The woman who lives next door is very kind.
errors.why: Para personas, who (o that), nunca which.

errors.wrong: The man who he works at the bakery is my cousin.
errors.right: The man who works at the bakery is my cousin.
errors.why: Who ya es el sujeto: no repitas he.

errors.wrong: The cake that I made it was delicious.
errors.right: The cake that I made was delicious.
errors.why: That ya ocupa el lugar de it: no lo repitas.

errors.wrong: This is the shop who sells cheap phones.
errors.right: This is the shop which sells cheap phones.
errors.why: Una tienda es una cosa: which o that.

errors.wrong: That's the street which I grew up.
errors.right: That's the street where I grew up.
errors.why: Un lugar donde pasa algo: where.

errors.wrong: The people what live there are lovely.
errors.right: The people who live there are lovely.
errors.why: What no es relativo; para personas, who o that.

exercises.q: My sister is the person ___ always listens to me.
exercises.why: Mi hermana es una persona: who.

exercises.q: This is the necklace ___ my mum gave me.
exercises.why: Un collar es una cosa: which (o that).

exercises.q: That's the café ___ we meet every Friday.
exercises.why: Es el lugar donde quedamos: where.

exercises.q: I've got a neighbour ___ grows amazing tomatoes.
exercises.why: Una vecina es una persona: who.

exercises.q: Is this the bus ___ goes to the hospital?
exercises.why: El autobús es una cosa: that (o which).

exercises.q: The village ___ my mother was born is very small.
exercises.why: El pueblo donde nació: where.

exercises.q: The man who ___ next door is a retired teacher.
exercises.why: Who ya es el sujeto: no se repite he. Y con the man, lives con -s.

exercises.q: The soup ___ was lovely.
exercises.why: Detrás viene otro sujeto (you): el relativo se puede quitar, pero no se repite it.

exercises.q: My grandson is a boy ___ loves football.
exercises.es: Mi nieto es un chico al que le encanta el fútbol.
answer: who
that
exercises.why: Para personas: who (o that).

exercises.q: I can't find the photos ___ you sent me.
exercises.es: No encuentro las fotos que me mandaste.
answer: that
which
exercises.why: Las fotos son cosas: that o which.

exercises.q: That's the hospital ___ my son was born.
exercises.es: Ese es el hospital donde nació mi hijo.
answer: where
exercises.why: Lugar donde pasó algo: where.

exercises.q: I love people ___ make me laugh.
exercises.es: Me encanta la gente que me hace reír.
answer: who
that
exercises.why: People son personas: who o that.

exercises.q: The recipe ___ you gave me was perfect.
exercises.es: La receta que me diste salió perfecta.
answer: that
which
exercises.why: Una receta es una cosa: that o which. (También se puede quitar.)

exercises.q: Do you remember the hotel ___ we stayed in Rome?
exercises.es: ¿Te acuerdas del hotel donde nos quedamos en Roma?
answer: where
exercises.why: Nos quedamos allí, en ese lugar: where.

exercises.instr: Une las dos frases con who
exercises.q: I have a friend. She lives in Valencia.
answer: I have a friend who lives in Valencia.
I've got a friend who lives in Valencia.
exercises.why: Who sustituye a she: no la repitas.

exercises.instr: Une las dos frases con which
exercises.q: This is the jumper. I bought it in London.
answer: This is the jumper which I bought in London.
exercises.why: Which sustituye a it: no lo repitas.

exercises.instr: Une las dos frases con where
exercises.q: This is the market. I buy my fruit there.
answer: This is the market where I buy my fruit.
exercises.why: Where sustituye a there.

exercises.q: The woman that I met at the party was lovely.
answer: The woman I met at the party was lovely.
exercises.why: Detrás viene otro sujeto (I), así que that se puede quitar.

exercises.q: The woman which lives upstairs is very kind.
exercises.why: Para personas, who (o that), nunca which.

exercises.q: That's the shop who sells cheap phones.
exercises.why: Una tienda es una cosa: which (o that).

exercises.q: This is the street which I grew up.
exercises.why: La calle donde crecí: where.

exercises.q: Do you know the people what live there?
exercises.why: What no sirve como relativo; para personas, who.

exercises.q: She's the friend who always help me.
exercises.why: Who se refiere a the friend (ella): el verbo lleva -s.

exercises.es: Mi hija es la persona que más me hace reír
exercises.answer: My daughter is the person who makes me laugh most
exercises.why: La persona que…: the person who…

exercises.es: Este es el pueblo donde nací
exercises.answer: This is the village where I was born
exercises.why: Lugar: where.

exercises.es: El pastel que hiciste estaba buenísimo
exercises.answer: The cake you made was delicious
exercises.why: Se puede quitar el relativo, pero nunca se añade it.

exercises.q: Tengo una amiga que habla cuatro idiomas.
answer: I have a friend who speaks four languages.
I've got a friend who speaks four languages.
I have a friend that speaks four languages.
I've got a friend that speaks four languages.
exercises.why: Una amiga (persona): who o that.

exercises.q: ¿Es este el autobús que va al centro?
answer: Is this the bus that goes to the centre?
Is this the bus which goes to the centre?
Is this the bus that goes to the town centre?
Is this the bus which goes to the town centre?
Is this the bus that goes to the city centre?
Is this the bus which goes to the city centre?
exercises.why: El autobús (cosa): that o which.

exercises.q: The doctor who looked after my mum was wonderful.
answer: El médico que cuidó a mi madre fue maravilloso.
El médico que cuidó a mi madre era maravilloso.
La médica que cuidó a mi madre fue maravillosa.
La médica que cuidó a mi madre era maravillosa.
El médico que cuidó de mi madre fue maravilloso.
exercises.why: The doctor who… = el médico que…

exercises.context: Le enseñas a una amiga una foto de tu vecina, la que te riega las plantas cuando viajas.
options: She's the neighbour who waters my plants.
She's the neighbour which waters my plants.
She's the neighbour who she waters my plants.
exercises.answer: She's the neighbour who waters my plants.
exercises.why: Persona: who, y sin repetir she.

exercises.context: Pasas por delante de la cafetería donde conociste a tu marido y se lo cuentas a una amiga.
options: That's the café where I met my husband.
That's the café which I met my husband.
That's the café where I met my husband there.
exercises.answer: That's the café where I met my husband.
exercises.why: Lugar: where, y sin repetir there.
Cada relativo y para qué sirve.

exercises.q: The friend ___ I told you about is coming tomorrow.
exercises.why: Una amiga es una persona: who (o that, o nada).
